About

I’m a Master of Computer Science student at Johns Hopkins University, interested in AI agents, AI infrastructure, and LLM inference.

My experience includes developing DynaFace, an iOS app for facial palsy assessment, training a small language model, and building an AI agent system.

    DynaFace Mobile

    2026.03 – 2026.07

    Graduate Software Engineer · Johns Hopkins University Medicine

    Built an iOS app in SwiftUI for AI-assisted facial palsy assessment, used by patients and clinicians at Johns Hopkins University Medicine.

    Implementation details +
    • Owned the flow from guided video capture and upload to cloud inference, annotated video, and a five-area scorecard.
    • Built email verification, password reset, account deletion, and patient controls to hide their data from selected clinicians.
    • Designed a serverless Firebase and Google Cloud backend with asynchronous video jobs, targeting capacity for 1,000–2,000 patients.
